content: Installed Gesture Handler 2.32.0 uses Gesture builders, not current 3.x usePanGesture APIs. Android Pan.activateAfterLongPress schedules native activation while stationary, fails before activation after platform touch slop, cancels on extra pointers. Race arbitration and Simultaneous composition are documented in version 2.x. Focal point must be taken after pinch activation. A dedicated delayed reorder Pan can race ordinary one-finger pan/tap; multi-touch camera remains simultaneously recognized with state ownership guards.
